mutation.subject: the reference's own scene graph, damaged by declared reference-only controls

subjects.note: Both sides of every comparison are the reference. The undamaged capture stands in for the reference and the damaged capture for a candidate, so the metrics are the acceptance metrics unchanged.

control.note: The same 12 units the geography layer's severe elevation control uses. Geography fills 84 to 86 per cent of every auxiliary frame, so leaving it undamaged would calibrate the largest group against nothing. It is one group, so it claims the worst-case depth metric and the pixel-weighted semantic ones, not the group-weighted means.
